collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A scholar realizes that the map they drew last season placed a stream on the wrong side of a hill.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a scholar, realizes that the map they drew last season placed a stream on the wrong side of a hill.

choices.label: Ask Others to Check the Rest of the Map.
Walk the Path Again to Confirm.
Add a Note About the Mistake to the Map.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Villagers appreciate the honesty and trust the map more.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some had already used the wrong map, but no harm came of it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Two more small errors are found and corrected.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The scholar finds the stream exactly where expected the second time.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The scholar discovers a new path they had missed before.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Future readers learn from the scholar's careful correction.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A child adds a doodle beside the note, which the scholar leaves in place.

b2__fx.name: Outcome B2
b2__fx.text: The rest of the map is accurate, and the scholar feels relieved.
